posts.title: Finding your kind of Pune
posts.summary: A neighbourhood is more than a pin on a map. Start with how you want your everyday life to feel.
body: Before making a shortlist, think about an ordinary Tuesday. Where will you work? How far do you want to travel? Do you prefer a quiet walk or a lively café around the corner?
Koregaon Park, Baner, Viman Nagar and Hinjawadi each offer different surroundings. Visit the locality at the times you would normally travel, and check everyday essentials in person.
Share your priorities with the agency: commute, budget, space and the things you cannot compromise on. A focused conversation can make the search more manageable.

posts.title: A few things to ask before you rent
posts.summary: The small questions that help you understand the full picture before choosing your next home.
body: Ask what the quoted rent includes. Maintenance, parking, utilities and any furnishing charges can change the overall monthly cost.
Confirm the available date, deposit, notice period and move-in condition. Request the written terms before making a payment.
Walk through the home, check the fixtures, and make a clear record of its condition. This article is an illustrative checklist, not advice about a particular agreement.

posts.title: What makes a shared stay feel like home?
posts.summary: Looking beyond the bed: sharing, meals and everyday comforts that make the difference.
body: Check the sharing arrangement, storage, bathroom access and house rules before choosing a PG. The details matter as much as the photograph.
Ask about meal timings, Wi-Fi, housekeeping, laundry, visitors and any additional charges. Confirm which services are included in the advertised price.
Availability and deposits can change. Talk to the agency, arrange a visit and confirm the written terms before paying.
